name: Alpha Vantage
rate_limits: 25 requests a day on the free key; unlimited for verified open source or educational projects (source: https://www.alphavantage.co/support/).
history_start: FX daily from 2007-08 (FX_DAILY full output with the public demo key returned 5,000 days, tested).
what_it_has: Daily, weekly and monthly FX bars, US economic indicators, and NEWS_SENTIMENT with sentiment scores that can be filtered by currency (for example FOREX:USD). Intraday FX is premium.
simple: A company with a free but very small allowance of price and news data each day.
license_terms: Use under the Alpha Vantage terms of service, accepted when getting a key. https://www.alphavantage.co/terms_of_service/
quality_notes: The 25 a day cap makes backfills slow. Economic indicators are actual values only, no forecasts. The source of FX quotes is not stated.

relevance.reason: Currency tagged news sentiment is interesting, but the free cap is tiny unless we get the educational exemption.
